prompt:
Mobile-first web app screen for the real product「台灣停車預測」at portrait 390×844, shown edge to edge with no browser or device frame. A driver arriving near「新莊體育館」needs to compare individual roadside parking spaces and nearby lots. Make this a working map screen, with a compact destination search, a large street map, a bottom results sheet, ordinary touch-friendly controls and a four-item bottom navigation. Let a clear street-atlas index lead: every roadside space has a short number on the map and the matching number in the list, while each pin remains individually tappable; show one separate blue off-street garage marker. Select「正中路 25 號」and show a compact card with「目前觀測：有位」「資料品質：可用」「一般汽車適用性：已確認」「官方觀測時間：未提供」「系統取得：10:28」「收費：20 元／小時」「抵達預測：資料不足」. Include occupied and unknown spots in map and list. Preserve the useful content below the first view: nearby comparison rows and a visible source-quality note.
Use the restrained paper and index language of a pocket city atlas: warm ivory ground, ink dark typography, blue-gray road labels, brick-red and ochre spot index colors, a sparse printed grid. Each status must differ in shape and text as well as color. Mark sample content「示意資料」. Do not imply live data or prediction skill; do not invent an ETA, availability odds, or official observation time. No event, comic, poster, album, or paper-fold metaphor. The result must read immediately as a normal, usable parking map, not a printed artifact.
